title: Implement Modern Authentication Service
problem_statement: Current VB6 login form lacks modern security standards required for banking applications
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access, regulatory compliance violations, data breaches
suggested_approach: Create OAuth2/JWT-based authentication service with MFA support, replace VB6 login form with secure web interface
success_criteria: Secure session management with JWT tokens

title: Secure Database Access Layer
problem_statement: ADO-based database access creates SQL injection vulnerabilities and lacks modern security patterns
risk_if_unaddressed: SQL injection attacks, data corruption, unauthorized data access
suggested_approach: Replace ADO with parameterized queries using modern ORM, implement connection pooling and encryption
success_criteria: All database queries use parameterized statements

title: Modernize Transaction Processing
problem_statement: VB6 forms handle financial transactions without proper validation, audit trails, or error handling
risk_if_unaddressed: Financial data corruption, regulatory non-compliance, transaction failures
suggested_approach: Create RESTful transaction services with comprehensive validation, audit logging, and rollback capabilities
success_criteria: All transactions logged with full audit trail
Input validation on all transaction parameters

title: Convert VB6 Forms to Modern Web UI
problem_statement: VB6 MDI forms are outdated and not accessible via modern web browsers or mobile devices
risk_if_unaddressed: Poor user experience, accessibility issues, deployment limitations
suggested_approach: Generate React/Angular components from VB6 forms, maintain functional parity with improved UX
success_criteria: All VB6 forms converted to responsive web components
